name: Dark Lab
description: Numerous kemet warriors, necromancers, and undead guard this subterranean facility, located near Night Mansions. This is where they conduct experiments to develop new types of undead. It has many chambers and testing fields, with cages and prisons where they confine both the created undead and subjects for experimentation. The central chamber is the reanimation atrium, where the main tests are performed. There are also pits, with giant caldrons filled with bubbling green liquid. Many incubators, bone depots, and processors for failed experiments can be found everywhere. Kemets commonly capture creatures from various species for their experiments. After the transformation, the Kemets usually teleport the experiments to specific locations to be tested or lock them in prison. These creatures maintain their intelligence and memories for one week, after which they fall completely under kemet control. Reversion is possible in the Dark Lab, on a specific incubator. Except for specific experiments, here is the undead they become:. Roll Common Elite 1 Zombie Death Knight 2 Ghoul Death Knight 3 Wight Mummy Lord 4 Mummy Mummy Lord 5 Revenant Vampire 6 Vampire Spawn Vampire
